environment.browserServer: production Node build with generated local-only secrets

acceptedDecision.moderation: Authors and workspace owners/admins may edit, delete and restore comments. Original authors remain immutable; editor/deleter IDs and timestamps are server-generated. Deleted comments remain thread placeholders; stale edits retain drafts for explicit review.

evidence: Two real Better Auth sessions see the same authored rich comment and eligible mention after reload.
Replies, rich formatting, admin edits, deleted placeholders and restoration survive reload.
One activity outbox event and one event per distinct newly mentioned eligible user commit with the comment.
Concurrent exact retries create one comment, audit record and activity/mention event set.
Lost response after commit, reload and exact retry produce one comment.
Private-team ineligible and nonexistent targets yield the same generic rejection and no partial comment, receipt or events.
Author and recipient fields cannot be supplied by clients.
Live access is rechecked on replay; uncertain authorization failures retain the original command identity.
Account/session changes remount private editor state and ignore stale responses.
Closed JSON node/mark vocabulary rejects script nodes, event-handler attributes, embeds, unsafe URLs, invalid nesting and oversized content.
Stored hostile script, handler and unsafe-link fixtures render inert fallback text after reload, without executable DOM or unsafe navigation.
Rich editor initialization and shared read renderer both validate untrusted stored documents.

postgresComments.note: Includes the final distinct/self-mention event behavior; delivery policy stays with FOR-33/FOR-65.

appTests.note: One unrelated emoji-picker async loading test timed out under parallel build/default-worker load; the bounded-worker full run passed. The final additional PostgreSQL-only mention test is covered separately above.

checks: post-commit response loss and reload replay

storageAndEvents.storage: Existing canonical issues.properties.comments JSON aggregate, protected by row locking and per-comment versions; issue revision triggers remain authoritative.
storageAndEvents.recipientPolicy: Recipients derive only from distinct structured mention nodes and live recipient-specific issue access. Unchanged mentions do not emit another mention event. Self-mentions remain durable events; downstream delivery decides notification policy.
storageAndEvents.draftLifecycle: Private authenticated product-state copies are visibility-filtered and included in issue recovery/purge filtering. Deleted bodies are redacted from read projections; unrelated property edits preserve the authoritative stored discussion.
storageAndEvents.queryClockFix: Issue pagination snapshots use the database clock that assigns created_at; observed local/database skew otherwise hid newly committed fixtures.
